claims.claim: More than 6,400 older Australians died last year while waiting to receive home care, an increase of more than a third on the previous year, averaging 17 a day.
claims.episode_span: more than 6,400 older Australians died last year while waiting to receive home care
claims.source_title: An average of 17 older Australians died each day last year waiting for home care
claims.supporting_quote: More than 6,400 older Australians died while waiting to receive home care last year, an increase of more than a third on the previous year.

claims.claim: Kim Yo-jong denounced on Thursday South Korea’s medical-equipment aid plan as a political provocation and a violation of sovereignty.
claims.episode_span: denounced on Thursday South Korea’s plan to provide medical equipment
claims.source_title: North Korea decries medical aid, says ‘nothing to give or receive’ from Seoul
claims.supporting_quote: North Korea’s Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of leader Kim Jong-un, denounced on Thursday South Korea’s plans to provide medical equipment aid to Pyongyang, calling it a “political provocation” and violation of its sovereignty.

claims.claim: Kim criticised Seoul for publicising UN sanctions-exemption efforts and said references to medicine shortages and deteriorating health conditions insulted North Korea.
claims.episode_span: insulted the North by referring to shortages of medicines and equipment
claims.source_title: North Korea decries medical aid, says ‘nothing to give or receive’ from Seoul
claims.supporting_quote: Kim criticised Seoul for publicising its efforts to obtain United Nations sanctions exemptions for a medical aid package, saying Seoul had “insulted” North Korea by referring to shortages of medicines and medical equipment and deteriorating health conditions.

claims.claim: China’s funding of multilateral development institutions is up tenfold since 2010, development-bank funding reached $3 billion in 2024, UN development-related funding rose 47 percent, climate finance reached $5.25 billion in 2025, and Gavi support was cut 32 percent.
claims.episode_span: raised funding of multilateral development institutions tenfold since 2010
claims.source_title: China's funding of development institutions is up sharply, but its power still lags, study shows
claims.supporting_quote: China, the world's second-largest economy, has boosted funding of multilateral development institutions tenfold since 2010, but its voting power and presence in international bodies still lag its economic weight, a new study released on Thursday said.

claims.claim: Ian Mitchell said the increase is a big step from 15 years ago but a tiny share of China’s economy, and that funding has been selective.
claims.episode_span: a big step up from 15 years ago but a tiny share of China’s economy
claims.source_title: China's funding of development institutions is up sharply, but its power still lags, study shows
claims.supporting_quote: "This is a big step up from 15 years ago, but it's still a tiny share of China's economy," said Ian Mitchell, co-author of the report, noting China's funding decisions had been quite selective.

claims.claim: China’s World Bank share is around 6 percent, less than half the formula, while the US share is around 16 percent with veto power.
claims.episode_span: China’s World Bank share of around 6 percent is less than half
claims.source_title: China's funding of development institutions is up sharply, but its power still lags, study shows
claims.supporting_quote: China's share of the World Bank of around 6% is less than half what the fund's own economic formula suggests, while the US retains veto power with its shareholding of around 16%.

claims.claim: China finished the New Yalu River Bridge in 2014; North Korea delayed its side for 12 years; work resumed after Xi Jinping’s June visit; neither side has set an opening date.
claims.episode_span: China finished the New Yalu River Bridge at Dandong in 2014
claims.source_title: China border town can't shake the blues despite promise of bridge to North Korea
claims.supporting_quote: While China completed the bridge in 2014, hoping to boost trade ties, North Korea left its approach roads and customs facilities unfinished as relations soured over Pyongyang’s nuclear tests and the UN sanctions that followed.

claims.claim: Three people, Baburam, Udayveer and Mahendra, died after a man drove a tractor into a crowd in Bijnor, according to Circle Officer Des Deepak Singh.
claims.episode_span: Baburam, Udayveer and Mahendra died after a man drove a tractor into a crowd in Bijnor
claims.source_title: Three killed as man drives tractor into crowd in Uttar Pradesh's Bijnor
claims.supporting_quote: The injured were taken to a community health centre, where Baburam and Udayveer died. Mahendra succumbed to his injuries at a private hospital, says Chandpur Circle Officer Des Deepak Singh

claims.claim: Vijayapura police registered an FIR against MLA Basanagouda Patil Yatnal over alleged false death certificates aimed at removing voters during the Special Intensive Revision; he was expelled by the BJP in March 2025.
claims.episode_span: registered an FIR against MLA Basanagouda Patil Yatnal
claims.source_title: FIR against MLA for creating false death certificates of voters in Vijayapura
claims.supporting_quote: Vijayapura police have registered an FIR against Basanagouda Patil Yatnal, MLA, on the charge of creating false death certificates of voters in a bid to exclude them from the voting list in Vijayapura Assembly constituency in Karnataka.

claims.claim: An AI-generated video during One Nation’s Victoria campaign prompted a push to ban election deepfakes.
claims.episode_span: An AI-generated video released during One Nation’s Victoria campaign
claims.source_title: Push to ban deepfakes following One Nation campaign ad
claims.supporting_quote: The release of an AI-generated video during One Nation’s campaign in Victoria has sparked a push to ban election deepfakes.

claims.claim: US Magistrate Judge Steve Kim on Wednesday ordered Wanying Zhang held; her lawyers said the case concerns one day of alleged surveillance in Seattle and that she looks forward to establishing innocence.
claims.episode_span: Magistrate Judge Steve Kim ordered Wanying “Heather” Zhang held
claims.source_title: US judge blocks release of alleged Beijing agent accused of filming Taiwan leader’s son
claims.supporting_quote: A federal judge on Wednesday ordered Wanying “Heather” Zhang be held in custody, after her lawyers – who had fought to keep her out of jail – said she “looks forward to establishing” her innocence at trial.

claims.claim: The European Parliament voted 454 to 86 for a resolution on economic reciprocity toward China, and Maroš Šefčovič is meeting Wang Wentao in Beijing to narrow a 360 billion euro deficit.
claims.episode_span: voted on Wednesday, 454 to 86, for a resolution centred on economic reciprocity
claims.source_title: EU sends envoy to Beijing as rising exports from China raise economic anxiety
claims.supporting_quote: On Wednesday, they voted 454 to 86 on a resolution to toughen up on China that centered on a call for “economic reciprocity and a proportionate EU response if China does not open its markets.”

claims.claim: Hilde Vautmans said Europe has economic power and it is time to use it; France’s planning commission in February called for 30 percent tariffs on many Chinese exports.
claims.episode_span: said Europe has economic power and that the time to use it has come
claims.source_title: EU sends envoy to Beijing as rising exports from China raise economic anxiety
claims.supporting_quote: Ahead of the vote, Hilde Vautmans, the Belgian lawmaker who led the resolution, said that “Europe has economic power, it’s time we used it.”

claims.claim: Narendra Modi said 5G had reached every Indian district with more than 5.5 lakh base stations, speeds were tenfold versus 2022, DBT delivered 50 lakh crore rupees with about 5 lakh crore saved, and PM-KISAN transferred more than 4 lakh crore rupees.
claims.episode_span: 5G connectivity had reached every district, with more than 5.5 lakh base stations
claims.source_title: ‘5G Has Reached Every District’: Modi Puts Mobile Phones at Centre of India’s Digital Push
claims.supporting_quote: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday said 5G connectivity had reached every district in India, with more than 5.5 lakh base stations supporting the network, as he highlighted the growing role of mobile phones in governance and the digital economy.
